cards.name: Category by budget month (UAH)
cards.sql: select coalesce(category, 'uncategorized') as category, budget_month, sum(amount_uah) as amount_uah from ledger_entries where status = 'kept' and budget_month is not null group by category, budget_month order by budget_month, category

cards.name: Total by budget month (UAH)
cards.sql: select budget_month, sum(amount_uah) as amount_uah from ledger_entries where status = 'kept' and budget_month is not null group by budget_month order by budget_month
